title: Map labelling #3
topic: university campus · sports centre · museum · botanical garden
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The university campus.
Guide: Welcome to the university campus. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the health centre is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the art studio. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the bike shed is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The sports hall is directly behind the art studio, at the back of the site.
Guide: The student union is directly behind the bike shed, at the back of the site.
Guide: The canteen is right next to the student union, on its left side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The sports centre.
Guide: Welcome to the sports centre. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the physio room. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the changing rooms is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the juice bar is the first building on your right.
Guide: The squash courts is directly behind the physio room, at the back of the site.
Guide: The climbing wall is right next to the squash courts, on its left side.
Guide: The weights room is directly behind the juice bar, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The museum.
Guide: Welcome to the museum. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the dinosaur hall is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the temporary exhibition is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the costume gallery. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: The cloakroom is directly behind the temporary exhibition, at the back of the site.
Guide: The archive room is right next to the cloakroom, on its right side.
Guide: The learning studio is directly behind the costume gallery, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The botanical garden.
Guide: Welcome to the botanical garden. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the herb garden is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the glasshouse. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the visitor centre is the first building on your right.
Guide: The pond is directly behind the visitor centre, at the back of the site.
Guide: The cactus house is directly behind the herb garden, at the back of the site.
Guide: The souvenir stall is right next to the cactus house, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
